description: Ines sends a message in the group chat about the shared birthday dinner, asking who will host.
Ines opens the group chat and reads her own message about the birthday dinner.
Kwame sends a message in the group chat: 'Hey, I'm away until Friday and can't host this time, but let me know if there's anything I can help with from my end.'
Bea opens her work schedule app and sees that she is scheduled to work Friday night (Oct 9) and Saturday night (Oct 10), both shifts ending at 7am the next morning.
Bea sends a message in the group chat: 'I checked my schedule and I'm working Friday and Saturday nights, so I can't host. Sorry!'
Bea opens the group chat and sees Kwame's message that he is away until Friday and cannot host.
Ines sends a message in the group chat: 'I could host if no one else volunteers, but I'd prefer someone else to take it. What do you all think?'
Ines's message 'I could host if no one else volunteers, but I'd prefer someone else to take it. What do you all think?' is sent to the group chat.
Ines opens the group chat and sees the new messages from Kwame and Bea.

Tomas opens the group chat and sees all the new messages: Kwame's message that he is away until Friday and cannot host, Bea's message that she is working Friday and Saturday nights and cannot host, and Ines's message offering to host but preferring someone else.
Ines opens the group chat and sees no new messages since her own last message.
Ines's message 'Okay, I can host. Let's plan for Saturday evening if that works for everyone.' is sent to the group chat.
Tomas opens the group chat and sees Ines's latest message offering to host on Saturday evening.
Ines opens her schedule app and sees that she has no commitments on Saturday evening, October 10, and that she has the day free to prepare.
Ines sends a message in the group chat: 'Could everyone please share any dietary restrictions or preferences for Saturday's dinner?'
Tomas picks up his phone and opens the group chat, seeing Ines's latest message asking about dietary restrictions.
Tomas sends a message in the group chat: 'No restrictions here, I eat anything.'
Tomas's message 'No restrictions here, I eat anything.' arrives in the group chat and becomes available to all members.

Bea wakes up briefly, picks up her phone, and sees the group chat has several unread messages. She opens the chat and sees Ines's messages offering to host and asking about dietary restrictions, as well as Tomas's reply. She reads them all.
Bea sends a message in the group chat: 'No restrictions for me, I'm good with anything. Thanks for hosting, Ines!'
Bea's message 'No restrictions for me, I'm good with anything. Thanks for hosting, Ines!' arrives in the group chat and becomes available to all members.
Tomas wakes up, picks up his phone, and opens the group chat. He sees Bea's message thanking Ines and saying she has no restrictions.
Ines opens the group chat and sees Tomas's message 'No restrictions here, I eat anything.' and Bea's message 'No restrictions for me, I'm good with anything. Thanks for hosting, Ines!'
Ines picks up her phone, opens the group chat, and sees Tomas's message about no restrictions and Bea's message thanking her and saying she has no restrictions.
Ines starts mentally planning a menu, considering pasta with a few options, but does not write anything down or take any concrete action yet.
Ines's message '@Kwame, any dietary restrictions or preferences for Saturday? I'm planning the menu.' is sent to the group chat and becomes available to all members.
Ines opens a note-taking app on her phone and creates a new note titled 'Shopping List' with items: pasta, tomato sauce, chicken or tofu, salad ingredients.
The shopping list note is saved on Ines's phone.
Ines adds olive oil, garlic, and bread to her shopping list note on her phone.
Tomas picks up his phone and opens the group chat, seeing Ines's message asking Kwame about dietary restrictions.
Kwame picks up his phone during a break, opens the group chat, and sees all the unread messages from Bea, Ines, and Tomas.
Kwame sends a message in the group chat: 'No restrictions for me, Ines. Thanks for hosting! I'll be back Friday so can help with setup or shopping then if needed.'
Kwame's message arrives in the group chat and becomes available to all members.
